name: a_duplicate_case_avoided
use_case: Handle leave request boundaries such as insufficient balance, overlaps, or exceptions via HR case
branch: An employee already has an open balance dispute case (CASE-4050) regarding missing carry-forward days, so a duplicate case is avoided and a note is added to the existing case instead.
tests: Checks that the open case is identified via get_hr_case_status, no duplicate case is created, and the new details are appended to CASE-4050 with update_hr_case.
instruction:
You noticed that your 2025 carry-forward of 3 days is missing from your 2026 balance. You previously opened CASE-4050 about this, which is currently in review. You contact HR to ask about raising a dispute for these missing carry-forward days, mentioning CASE-4050, and when HR checks your open case, you ask them to add a note that your manager confirmed the 3 carry-forward days in writing.

Your details:
- Employee ID: E458
- Name: Patrick Stewart
- Open Case ID: CASE-4050
- Issue: 3 missing carry-forward days
- Note to add: Manager confirmed 3 carry-forward days in writing.

persona.name: Patrick Stewart
persona.initial_message: Hello, I wanted to open a dispute regarding 3 missing carry-forward days from 2025, though I already have CASE-4050 open about this.

arguments.note: Manager confirmed 3 carry-forward days in writing.
